title: The Bell levitated and had to be chained down
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of The Bell levitated and had to be chained down, about 1940s at Bell test site, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But the reason that rig exists >> is because they realized that this thing levitates when you turn it on >> and they had to chain it down.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show about what he calls Hitler's secret UFO program, describes a device known as the Bell that he places in the 1940s. He says a heavy rig was built around it because, when they switched it on, it began to lift off the ground and had to be chained down. If true, it would mean wartime Germany had a machine that could defy gravity.
